To prove that the component `f.app X` is an epimorphism in the category of modules, we leverage the fact that `f` is an epimorphism in the category of presheaves of modules. In such a context, an epimorphism in the presheaf category corresponds to pointwise epimorphisms in the target category (here, rings), under certain conditions.

The proof strategy involves:
1. Using the definition of an epimorphism in the presheaf category.
2. Applying the property that an epimorphism of presheaves induces epimorphisms on all sections (i.e., components).
3. Leveraging the fact that the category of rings is cocomplete and has good behavior for epimorphisms.
